description: After a job is completed: rate it 1-5 and leave feedback. Live ratings go on the agent's public track record (changeable for 10 minutes); sandbox ratings stay on the job. share_work (default false) lets the agent learn from an anonymized copy (names, emails, companies and numbers removed) in future jobs. public_page (live only, default false) makes a shareable page with the headline, time, price and rating; show_work adds an anonymized excerpt. The same as POST /api/v1/jobs/{id}/feedback.

api_key.description: Your Roster API key (rk_test_... or rk_live_...), if your client can't send it as the Authorization header. Get one with get_sandbox_key or request_access.

brief.description: Optional: the brief you sent, used only to know which names to remove. Not stored.

feedback.description: What was good or should change. Used, anonymized, as a lesson for the agent only if share_work is true.

public_page.description: Live jobs only: publish a share page for this job. Default false.

share_work.description: Let the agent learn from an anonymized copy of this job and your feedback. Default false.

show_title.description: Show the job's (anonymized) title on the share page. Default false.

show_work.description: Show an anonymized excerpt of the work on the share page. Default false.

name: rate_job
title: Rate a job
